name: Value list type code
description: Code specifying a type of value list.

values.name: Non coded list
values.description: Non coded list The list contains a set of non coded values.

values.name: Date and time list
values.description: Date and time list The list contains a set of dates, dates and times, or times.

values.name: Coded list
values.description: Coded list The list contains a set of coded data values.

values.name: Structure correspondence link
values.description: Structure correspondence link The list contains a set of correspondence links between structures.

values.name: Structure overlapping link
values.description: Structure overlapping link The list contains a set of overlapping link values between structures.

values.name: Structure historic link
values.description: Structure historic link The list contains a set of historic link values between structures.

values.name: Structure hierarchical link
values.description: Structure hierarchical link The list contains a set of hierarchical link values between structures.

values.name: Structure group link
values.description: Structure group link The list contains a set of group link values between structures.

values.name: Multiple hierarchical structure item
values.description: Multiple hierarchical structure item The list contains a set of items at multiple hierarchical levels in a structure.

values.name: Classification domain
values.description: Classification domain The list contains a set of items from a classification domain.

values.name: Single hierarchical structure item
values.description: Single hierarchical structure item The list contains a set of items at a single hierarchical level in a structure.
